routes.name: Independently verify the geometric deformation implication
Find a countermodel satisfying every logarithm-colimit hypothesis
Refute a literal uniform geometric weight assertion
Use the scalar q-1 tower as a logarithm-colimit countermodel
routes.retired_because: Length-two compatibility forces a nonzero pure-weight map from w_i to w_(i+1)-2, hence w_i=w_0+2i. This scalar tower cannot have both compatible mixed lifts and uniform upper ordinary-fibre weights.

interpretation: Edges below decompose the manuscript's proposed proof, not a certificate of its correctness. The audit goal remains open; a refutation need not verify unrelated dependencies.

C9000069.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 069 (Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level.; papers: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

G069_MAIN.statement: thm:main: the full irrational-level quantum Langlands equivalence, with actual global forms, all components, collisions, and central torsor compatibility.

P069_IDENTITY.statement: planch:identity for both groups: J_s R_s is the identity for every irrational determinant exponent.

D069_TRANSFER.statement: The actual tested cone family has zero cohomology colimit at every non-root-of-unity monodromy.

D069_COLIMIT.statement: deform:colimit: compatible mixed logarithm lifts and degreewise uniform upper weights transfer ordinary-level zero cohomology colimits to every non-torsion monodromy.

R069_RANK.statement: deform:rank: finite geometric cohomology and map ranks are constant on the non-torsion monodromy locus.

D069_MIXED.statement: Every actual tested finite diagram and every transition is linear in one Kummer input and admits the compatible mixed logarithm lifts required in deform:colimit.

P069_STAGES.statement: deform:stages constructs the asserted coherent finite projection and augmented-stage diagrams.

Z069_ZERO.statement: planch:zero-colimit: each ordinary-level tested-cone stalk cohomology colimit vanishes.

W069_WEIGHT.statement: planch:weight-estimate: fixed stalk-degree weights of the actual tested cones have an upper bound independent of all stage indices.

W069_SEPARATION.statement: planch:separation: the actual finite terms have the displayed mixed Satake separation modulo axis constants with the claimed shifts.

W069_VACUUM.statement: planch:vacuum-weight: the two bar vacuum objects have global upper weights and the opposite relative Satake kernel weights cancel.

W069_DEGREE.statement: planch:satake-degree: there is a uniform upper ordinary degree for all labels and all collision fibres on fixed bundle charts.

W069_CONFIG.statement: planch:configuration-estimate: arrangement-link bounds, configuration integration, and skeletal shifts give the asserted degree decay and weight bounds.

S069_ORDINARY.statement: The ordinary geometric Langlands, enhanced Whittaker, and Lin comparison inputs apply with the precise conventions and parameters asserted by the manuscript.

P069_FINITE_TEST.statement: planch:finite-test: the fixed finite test kills the ordinary anti-tempered category and is conservative at irrational exponent, also with spectators.

P069_VINBERG.statement: deform:vinberg and the comparison through the compactified diagonal yield the required natural transformation.

P069_STALKS.statement: deform:stalks: the asserted chartwise holonomic Ind-category embedding and stalk detection apply to the colimits used here.

P069_PSEUDOIDENTITY.statement: Section 3 twisted pseudo-identity equivalence and its shifts; unexamined in this mission.

P069_PERIOD.statement: Sections 10-12 period and Ran integration identities; unexamined in this mission.

P069_LOCALIZATION.statement: equivalence:localization and the twisting identifications for the four localization functors; unexamined in this mission.

P069_COLLISIONS.statement: Sections 7-9 moving-point, collision, adjunction, and insertion comparisons; unexamined in this mission.

S069_LOCAL_INPUTS.statement: Known pointwise local equivalences and W-algebra reduction theorems do not by themselves establish the global deformation or collision implications.

P069_CENTRAL.statement: Section 13 component, global-form, and central-torsor compatibility; unexamined in this mission.

C069_SCALAR_EXCLUSION.statement: For the rank-one degree-zero tower over Q[q,q^-1] with transition q-1, the q=1 colimit is zero and the q=2 colimit is nonzero, but every compatible mixed logarithm lift would force ordinary-fibre weights w_i=w_0+2i. The tower is not an admissible countermodel to deform:colimit.

C069_CONFIG_PROPAGATION.statement: For curve-configuration collision links of rank c, assuming actual separated mixed objects have uniform complex weight W and all-fibre upper ordinary degree E, configuration integration and any skeletal shift give stalk cohomology weights at most W+E for every index and degree. This does not establish those actual geometric hypotheses.
